description: Download a file by module name. Construct the URL from a File/Image field value: field.path = '/s/{guid}/{fileName}'. Returns a pre-signed S3 URL (1hr TTL).

guid.description: Short ID from the file URL

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: download_file
title: Download File
